title: The Magical Golem's Sister
text: “In the timeline where Naofumi became friends with Gaelion, it was Rasaemon, you know.”
“Why Lars-chan?”
“Since there wasn’t much connection between Rafu and Sadi, I think the legend spread that he was close with the Shield Hero.”
“Oh my…?”
“Is that look totally based on my personal taste? Huh? Could it be that thing you mentioned before…?”
Just as my father tilted his head in confusion, Itsuki suddenly realized something.
“Wait, Gaelion-san!”
With a sharp “Zubishi!” Itsuki pointed at the golem calling itself Rafuemon.

“You said it didn’t matter whether it was Sadeena-san or Larsazusa-san when creating the Raph-species, but the dragon said ‘no’—is this why?! And asking me about it too—you definitely did this on purpose!”
“Huh? Huh? Itsuki-kun, what do you mean?”
“Rafuemon-san, you don’t need to worry about it.”
“That’s right!”
My Rival nodded cheerfully. Why exactly are dragons off-limits? It feels vaguely familiar—like something I might have seen in an anime when I was a kid in my own world.
“It’s not a name derived from ‘Dragon’—it’s taken from Gaelion, so ‘Ga-Emon’ is fine, isn’t it!”
“Gaelion is a name, not a species. Even if you create a ‘Ga-species’ or a ‘Nano-species,’ it’s still a Dragon.”
“True… If a Dragon had that name, it’d be dangerous in all sorts of ways. Even if the design were different, you know.”
“Nano-species” sounds like someone with a pretty high opinion of themselves! I won’t let a sycophantic speech pattern like yours surface in the future!

“Well… I did suspect there was something behind the way you subtly steered the conversation toward Itsuki… but does this mean that, looking back, I’ll be seen as someone who adored Raph-chan? Just like the ‘me’ Motoyasu-kun first knew?”
“Doesn’t that feel a little off?” Father looks at Big Sister.
“Oh my—”
“Well then, Naofumi-san, shall we change Rafuemon-san to Sadiemon-san?”
“No… you really don’t need to go that far. At least not that far. By the way, Rafuemon.”
“What is it?”
Rafuemon tilts his head slightly and looks at my Father and the others.
“Rafu—”
Standing next to my Big Sister and Raph-species, he looks like he’s from the same species.
“So you do have a little sister after all? It seems Gaelion-chan is going after your creator after she sends you off.”
“Naofumi-san… is that really what you’re worried about?”
“Well, isn’t it important? From a reincarnator’s perspective, there’s someone you should be wary of even more than me, right?”
For some reason, my Father turns his gaze toward me.
“You’re right, actually. I think the most dangerous person we need to be wary of is Motoyasu-san… but then, why are you asking Rafuemon-san about a younger sister…?”
“Hm? Could it be that Itsuki doesn’t know? No, maybe she doesn’t exist in Itsuki’s world? There’s this ‘phantom younger sister’ who only appears in five episodes of the original series—”
And with that, my Father began talking with great enthusiasm. Apparently, that phantom younger sister is a bird-shaped robot.
“So, when it comes to a younger sister, is it probably Rafumi-chan after all? I think there’s a chance it could be Philoko-chan, though.”
“I can kind of guess about Rafumi, but Philoko is a bit too obvious. It’s a countermeasure against Motoyasu, isn’t it?”
Just as Father was about to explain it to Itsuki, Rafuemon chimed in.
“Uh, well… I don’t know about that. Maybe one will be made after me, though.”
Just then, there was a crackling sound coming from the direction of Itsuki’s house, and something took flight, heading toward Fleon-chan.
“What was that sound just now?”
Immediately, Fleon-chan turned around and landed right here.
“Everyone’s gathered here, aren’t they!”

Next to her was something that looked like Filolial-sama, with an unnatural build slightly larger than Keel in his dog form. It was… well, relatively small but in a “Queen” form, if you will—that sort of vibe. She’s wearing a skirt. Not a bad design at all, is it?
“Whoa… something that looks like it was made specifically to deal with Motoyasu-kun just showed up.”
“Apparently, this one’s named Philoko-chan. She says she wants to help Fleon out, you know.”
“I’m Philoko-ddyu!”
…Her speech patterns are a little off. Her voice is slightly hoarse, too.
“…She really did show up.”
At that moment, Ren made a small victory gesture. Neither Father nor Itsuki noticed, but I saw it. I saw it clearly.
“Um, is she like Rafe-emon’s little sister or something?”
“That’s the backstory, ducky. The little sister of that clunky golem over there—Filoko-ducky.”
“I’m not some clunky golem! I’m Rafe-emon!”
“Shut up, ducky! The fact that some crappy reincarnated loser made you says it all, ducky.”
“T-that’s so mean…”
Rafuemon is clinging to Itsuki, crying because of how harshly he was spoken to. The Father in his head looks pretty envious.
“…They’re supposed to be siblings, but they don’t get along at all… So, Gaelion-chan, who’s this kid?”
“Huh? I don’t know this one. First time I’ve seen her.”
“Huh? Wait a sec. What do you mean you don’t know her!?”
“Just like with the Filolial Cross, you really never know what’s going to happen in a loop.”
Oh? Something’s happening that even our Rival doesn’t know about.
“Philoko’s goal is to assist Fleon-chan’s activities! We’re going to sing together!”
With a clunk, what looked like a sound system unfolded from Philoko’s back, and a microphone was handed to Fleon-chan. Then, a catchy tune began to play.
“This is great! Let’s sing!”
In time with the music, Fleon-chan changed her outfit and began to sing.
“Uwaa… No way… Even though we have gadgets from the future… Kuuuuu…”
“Itsuki-kun, pull yourself together!”
Itsuki began to writhe in agony. HAHAHA, his awakening is near, isn’t it?
“Stop, stop! We haven’t done the self-introductions yet, so save the singing for later!”
Father stepped in and scolded Fleon-chan. Itsuki, you’ve dodged a bullet there.
“Ah, I’d rather you didn’t do that later either! Rafuemon-san went out of his way to bring a countermeasure, but this just defeats the whole purpose!”
“That crappy item made by some pathetic reincarnated guy won’t work on Philoko-kyu! I’m going to carry out my righteous activities with Fleon-kyu. The Bow Hero—that’s my destiny, kyu!”
“Ah… So even if Rafuemon comes, there’s no resisting it?”
“Let’s just pray for Itsuki’s future.”

At Ren’s words, my Father brings his hands together in prayer. I’ll join him in prayer, too. It seems it’s a foregone conclusion that Itsuki will be awakened to justice by Fleon-chan’s song. I also remember how Ren was clenching his fist in delight.
“Not again! Don’t just decide things on your own! I’m definitely not going to ‘awaken’!”
“But this mockery directed at the reincarnated one sounds familiar…”
“Well, it is a Filolial creation, after all. It probably isn’t unrelated.”
It seems my Father and the others have an idea what’s going on. For some reason, they keep glancing at me.
“Destiny is meant to be defied,”
or so, for some reason, Itsuki said to me. I don’t get why he’s telling me this. Itsuki’s destiny is to become a hero alongside Fleon-chan.
“Your role is to entertain the crowd, Kyu! You’re an idol, Kyu!”
“What do you mean, ‘entertain’? I’m not becoming a hero or an idol!”

“An idol, huh… Itsuki is also good-looking, though not quite as much as Motoyasu-kun… If you put your mind to it, people would probably follow you. Like, singing and dancing and all that. Motoyasu-kun, Ren, and Itsuki all have good-looking faces, after all.”
“I know you have an inferiority complex about your looks, Naofumi-san, but that’s none of your business!”
My father-in-law has a face full of character, so there’s really no need to worry about it. If anything, isn’t the Father actually popular in all sorts of circles?
“Naofumi, you’re popular with the Demi-Humans and Beastmen, aren’t you? I’m sure by their standards, you’re even better-looking than us.”
Ren stepped in to back him up right there. That’s right. Standards of beauty change from world to world. I’m sure of it.

“Why am I getting backed up at a time like this? Nah, he’s just trying to draw attention to me. Let’s get back on track… Philoko-chan, was it? Could you tell me a bit more about yourself? I’ve heard some things from Rafuemon, too.”
My father-in-law asks the person who goes by Philoko and resembles Filolial-sama.
“If we consider Rafuemon-san’s actions as a countermeasure against Naofumi-san, does that mean there’s some ulterior motive behind his countermeasures against Motoyasu-san as well?”
“It seems even Gaelion-chan doesn’t know, so we’ve got no choice but to ask.”
“So, isn’t it likely that the Spear Hero was somehow created through some underhanded scheme?”
“That sounds plausible. Maybe he ordered the creation of a support mech—no, a golem—in the future to back up Fleon-san?”
“That’s right. He probably has Black Thunder’s support skills, too.”
It’s true that, as a way to help Fleon-chan, I’d want to quickly awaken her to justice. And that’s how he becomes the Dark Holy Hero and the Filolial Mask V3.
“Not quite right, but close, kyu. But it’s not that, kyu.”
“It isn’t?”
“I can’t tell you anything about the creator when it comes to the Bow Hero and the Sword Hero, kyu.”
“That makes the theory that Motoyasu is the culprit seem more plausible.”
“So that means you can tell Naofumi-san and Motoyasu-san, right?!”
“Naofumi!”
“I’m not ready to tell you yet. But there’s no doubt that Philoko’s design is tailored to the Spear Hero’s tastes.”
“Ah… I see. Get along well with Motoyasu, okay?”
If she’s modeled after Filolial-sama, I’d honestly be happy for you two to get closer. And together, you’ll awaken Itsuki and Ren.
“The awakening of Itsuki and Ren.”
“You’re really fired up, aren’t you!”
“Correction—don’t go overboard, okay?”
“So, if I’m going to reveal just a little bit of info, Philoko doesn’t have any bombs or anything like that. And unlike that clunker golem over there, she’s a golem built with the latest technology.”
Spreading her wings with a flutter, Philoko-chan says she’s a high-end model.
“Specifically, she’s built with technology that makes that pathetic reincarnated jerk who made that clunker golem look like nothing.”
“Calling me a ‘junk golem’ is rude! You’re my little sister, aren’t you?!”
“Tch! Having an incompetent older brother is such a hassle. The parts, model numbers, and even the creator are all different. The only thing we have in common is the ore used in our cores.”
Isn’t this already beyond just sharing the same raw materials? Still, there must be some reason they’re set up as siblings.
“It kind of reminds me of the Tiger Girl and Tiger Guy from the first world.”
“You mean Fohl-san and Atla-san? Like Rafuemon-san and Philoko-san…? I don’t see the connection at all.”
“I do feel like they’re similar, though.”
By the way, Tiger Guy has gone out to meet Tiger Girl and isn’t here right now. Lately, Tiger Guy seems to be following Father’s orders and assisting the Big Sisters with various tasks.
“As for Fohl-kun… I haven’t talked to Atla-chan much, but… I don’t think he’s anything like Philoko-chan.”

“It’s true—it’s rare to see a loop where the Tiger Girl starts picking fights with her older brother. In the first world, Wild Naofumi was muttering something like she wanted the Tiger Girl to be more well-behaved.”
“Hmm… I wonder what caused that to happen.”
“According to Tiger Guy, it seems to be because he met Naofumi.”
“Me and… well…”
“To get Naofumi-san to join our group, should we have him talk with Atla-san for a long time instead of the Raph-species? No… I suppose Naofumi-san is to Atla-san what Fleon-san is to me.”
“If Itsuki could use his ‘Hit’ ability again… Anyway, I really want the siblings to get along. Ideally, I’d like them to return to the future on good terms.”
My Father is suggesting a return to the future.
“Going back on a one-way ticket is impossible, you know. Time travel is a very difficult technique.”
“Huh? I can’t go back!?”
“Rafuemon, didn’t you know that?”
“Well, he seems like a hothead, so there’s no point in telling him. Rather than saying he can’t come back, it’s easier to say that someone will come to fetch him eventually.”
How pitiful.
“So there’s no time machine… If there were, I’d love to go to the future or the past… especially to change the past… especially when I think about Sadeena and the others.”
“There’s no record of anyone ever traveling further back in time than the period when the ‘wave’ described in the legends of Philoko’s era occurred.”
“There are stories about time-jumping Magic in ancient Magic, legends, and forbidden spells. But… I’ve heard it’s difficult to go back further than the ‘wave.’”
“Hmm… That sounds a lot like the mystery of Motoyasu-kun’s loop.”
It’s true—I am stuck in a loop, after all. In a way, it’s time travel.
“Anyway, so Rafuemon and the others came to this era on a one-way trip?”
“That’s right. This is the furthest back in time they could go. And it’s something that’s rarely possible.”
The furthest back in time, huh? So, in terms of my loop, the moment right after I was summoned must be the “present” for Filoko-chan and the others.
“They sent Rafuemon and the others here with such precision… Putting the pieces together, it seems like people connected to Itsuki and Rishia were involved in the development. Just a hunch.”
“I won’t deny it, kyu.”
“In a way, if Rafuemon is an assassin, does that mean Filoko-chan is an ally…?”
“I really can’t see it that way, though.”
“No need to worry about it. Just think of it as them being sent to other heroes, in line with the legend that the Shield Hero liked to bring Raph-species along with him.”
“Rafu-emon is more than enough already. Please go home.”
Itsuki stubbornly refused. If you don’t have a place to go, we’ll protect you.
